name: @stapel/chat-react
description: Headless React pair for stapel-chat: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, a seq-ordered thread store, and ONE transport seam behind which the module's own resumable WebSocket protocol (hello/welcome/replay/replay_done/message/error) and seq-anchored polling are interchangeable — the UI never knows which is live. Conversation list with unread badges, thread replay + live tail, REST send, direct-thread idempotency for "message the seller", monotonic read markers. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.

size-limit.name: index — headless pair (client + hooks + thread store + transport seam). Raised 9 -> 9.5 KB: measured 9.20 KB before the elevation gate landed (the in-flight subject/person work) and 9.28 KB after it (core's useElevation in StartDirectChat, ~83 B) Raised 9.5 -> 10.5 KB in 0.6.0: the presence reader/applier and the notification rules (model/presence.ts, model/notifications.ts) are headless by design. Measured 10.11 KB.

default — the antd chat skin must stay out of the main bundle. Raised 10 -> 13 KB: measured 12.17 KB after the inbox row became a person (avatar + name + subject + preview through the host people seam), the thread gained the pinned subject card and the report/block overflow sheet. The ceiling is the split, not the size — this subpath is opt-in and antd-carrying by design Raised 13 -> 14 KB in 0.6.0: the presence line and the notifications pre-prompt on the shared permission substrate. Raised 14 -> 14.5 KB in 0.7.1: the notification ask stopped being a modal (D64). PermissionSheet was ONE imported component; an ask that does not take the screen hostage is markup this package owns — an alert, its two controls and the denied arm — plus the whole-row link that made an inbox row one control instead of a name button (D65). Measured 14.33 KB against 13.97 KB before. Raised 14.5 -> 14.7 KB in 0.7.3: the conversation row's :focus-visible ring (D65 left the largest focus target on the screen with outline-style: none). Measured on a clean tree, this package's src reverted to the previous commit with dependencies held constant: 14.39 -> 14.53 KB, 140 B for a rule an inline style cannot state. 20 B of that was incidental and is gone — a single-element array joined to a string, a second constant for the hoist key the class name already was, and the style element written once per branch instead of once — which leaves 14.51 KB and no fat left to cut.

i18n/ru — the Russian bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry (4.5 KB since the wire cutover: four more NAMED degradations, in full sentences, is the point of them). Raised 4.5 -> 4.8 KB: measured 4.46 KB with the person/subject/menu copy, which leaves no room for a word Raised again 4.8 -> 5.2 KB in 0.6.0: presence and the notifications pre-prompt add seven keys, three of them full sentences — the permission copy has to say what the offer is FOR before a browser prompt appears, and a short version of that sentence is how a person refuses something they did not understand. Measured 4.79 KB.

i18n/es — the Spanish bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry. Raised 3.5 -> 3.8 KB: measured 3.62 KB with the eleven keys the person/subject/menu copy added Raised again 3.8 -> 4.3 KB in 0.6.0: the same seven presence + notification-permission keys. Measured 3.94 KB.
